subject: Pilot next steps: exec intro + technical deep-dive scheduling
messages:
From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Torres <elena.torres@retailwave.com>, Ryan Smith <ryan.smith@retailwave.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-10-04T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Pilot recap + proposal for exec intro and infra deep-dive

Hi Elena / Ryan —

Thanks for the call this morning — good conversation and helpful context. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we have alignment: 

Recap (high level)
- Primary objective: Evaluate Redwood for a pilot focused on customer-facing search augmentation (embeddings + generation) across ~10M monthly tokens.
- Key constraints: 99th-pct latency target ~200ms for short queries, strict PII handling in search vectors, retention policy = 30 days for indexed vectors.
- Decision-makers: Maria Lopez (CTO) + VP of Product (TBD) for architectural sign-off and commercial ok.

What we suggest next
1) 30m exec alignment (VP/CTO) — short product + success criteria discussion to unblock pilot contract terms.
2) 60m technical deep-dive — infra, networking, KV/cache behavior, quantization/latency profiles and runbook for pilot.

Proposed windows (all PT) — please confirm which one works and who will attend: 
- Tue Oct 10: 11:00–12:00 PT
- Wed Oct 11: 09:00–10:00 PT
- Thu Oct 12: 16:00–17:00 PT

Attachments: redwood-pilot-precall-pack.pdf (summary + sample configs), deployment-options-diagram.png (networking + VPC options).

If any of those windows are tricky, tell me two alternatives and we’ll follow-up. If you want Maria (CTO) included, we can split the slot: 30m exec (9:00–9:30) + 60m infra (9:30–10:30) on the same day.

Next actions
- Elena / Ryan: confirm preferred window and attendees
- Redwood: will prep a concise pre-read and a runbook for the deep-dive (attachments above)

Thanks — look forward to locking this in.

Best,
Priyom
Priyom Das | Senior Account Exec
Redwood Inference
From: Elena Torres <elena.torres@retailwave.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>, Ryan Smith <ryan.smith@retailwave.com>
Date: 2028-10-04T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot recap + proposal for exec intro and infra deep-dive

Priyom — thanks for the clear recap. Quick replies inline below.

We can do Wed Oct 11 and Maria Lopez (CTO) should be able to join for 09:00–09:30 PT. If possible, please plan for 09:00–09:30 exec intro and then 09:30–10:30 for the technical deep-dive. That gives Maria time for a quick product alignment and then hand off to engineering.

A couple of asks from our side before the deep dive:
- Can you surface any SOC2 / data residency references up front? Alex Chu (our security lead) will want to skim technical controls before attending.
- Please include an expected token-cost estimate for the pilot (ballpark per month) so procurement can pre-qualify.

I will loop in Maria and Alex on the calendar when we lock time. Ryan and I will also invite the product lead (TBD) to the deep-dive portion.

Thanks — 11th at 09:00 PT works for us as you suggested.

—Elena
Elena Torres
Head of Platform Partnerships, RetailWave
